title: Black Early Loading Screen
description: Early Mojang loading screen becomes black (monochrome)
body:
Works exactly like the Vanilla "**Monochrome Logo**" setting.

The “**Monochrome Logo**” setting in Minecraft’s settings menu becomes redundant.

# When is this useful?

If your modpack ships with a `defaultoptions.txt` from **KubeJS**, the "**Monochrome Logo**" setting will not apply on the very first launch. This lightweight  mod fixes that bug.

# To make this mod work:

**In:**

`YourMinecraftInstance\config\fml.toml`

**Change:**

earlyWindowProvider = "fmlearlywindow"

**To:**

earlyWindowProvider = "blackearlywindow"
